description_short: Exports read-only factory counts, live area recipes, terrain sorter configuration, reserves, operating history, and train traffic health to the local CoI calculator.
description_long: Writes a local JSON snapshot containing vehicle totals, named vehicle areas, completed buildings and construction ghosts with effective machine recipes, mine-tower-to-sorter assignments, configured terrain products and focus-adjusted sorter throughput, selected train-station products and loading direction, Groundwater Pump identity, pause state, locations, vehicle-zone membership, aquifer reserve and capacity, and depleted-output settings, recipe-aware production identities, zone-aware Data Centers, Water Chillers, greenhouse configurations, rocket infrastructure, solar panels, maintenance depots, and stationary tracked infrastructure, eligible standalone Gold and Fuel Gas reserves, current repeatable research and edicts, completed-cycle operating averages, and sustained train track waits. It does not modify gameplay state or expose a network service.
